content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Ogden

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you hold a secondary degree or equivalent and meet PMI's education requirement. No project management work experience is required—a key advantage for Ogden professionals entering or transitioning into the field. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria to confirm your readiness.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format condenses the required contact hours into a focused learning experience, combining PMBOK® Guide fundamentals with real-world scenarios relevant to Utah's project-driven sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your education hours, create your PMI account and submit your official CAPM application. You'll pay the associated exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy guides you through each field to ensure a clean, timely submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—study guides, practice questions, and instructor feedback—to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam with Pearson VUE at your preferred testing center. Our instructors remain available to clarify complex topics before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Upon passing, you'll earn the CAPM credential and enter PMI's three-year renewal cycle. Stay current by earning professional development units through continued learning, volunteering, or exam retakes. Renewal keeps your credential active and your market value strong.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.

CAPM serves as a recognized entry point toward the PMP credential that aerospace and defense employers—and federal-adjacent roles—often prefer or require. It demonstrates formal project management training and positions you competitively for advancement in Ogden's strongest-demand sector.
